executionMode: fresh historical discovery + exact v2.4 deterministic replay where auditable production inputs were reconstructable; fixture-local non-reconstructable states terminalized NO_MODEL and execution continued
continuationInvariant: all requested date × configured-league checkpoints terminal; no fixture-local failure stopped execution

failureAnalysis.detail: Fixtures without an auditable current-model attack/defence input state were terminalized NO MODEL rather than approximated. This was concentrated on 28 Sep–1 Oct and fixtures omitted from preserved Oct 2–4 input snapshots.
High/low/total lambda gates removed several high-confidence legacy candidates from automatic publication, including known historical losing cases.

improvementCandidates: Persist the exact production ModelInput object for every modelled fixture, including NO BET/REVIEW outputs, so future backtests can replay all fixtures end-to-end.
Add a deterministic, versioned historical-input builder to the repository; generic recent-form data must not require an undocumented conversion into attack/defence strengths.
Use the completed sample plus a larger holdout before changing v2.4 thresholds; do not tune to the single Deportivo Pasto vs Fortaleza loss.
